newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares rise after budget clears parliament.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares rise after budget clears parliament.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse opened higher in brisk trade on Monday, driven by news that the lower house of parliament had passed the Finance Bill of the 1997/98 (April-March) federal budget, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index rose 4.01 points to 775.92 after the first 30 minutes of trade.
Brokers said buying by foreign investors and speculators was steady on the first day of settlement in A-stocks.
"It seems the market has bottomed out and should recover from this level," said Vijay Aggarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
The lower house of parliament on Friday approved the Finance Bill, which was presented by Finance Minister P.Chidambaram on February 28 in a 1997/98 investor friendly, tax-cutting budget.
Reliance Industries was quoted one rupee higher at 301.75 rupees.
State Bank of India shares gained 2.70 rupees, rising to 309 rupees.
